mapper.select: SELECT CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) AS orderId, om.camp_id AS campId, om.out_order_no AS outOrderNo, om.order_no AS orderNo, om.guest_name AS guestName, r.room_name AS roomName, rc.name AS roomCategoryName, ca.channel_id AS channelId, ca.channel_name AS channelName, om.status AS orderStatus, om.start_at AS startAt, om.created_at AS createdAt FROM order_main om LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = om.room_id LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id LEFT JOIN channel_account ca ON ca.account_id = om.channel_id AND ca.camp_id = om.camp_id WHERE om.camp_id = #{campId} AND om.is_deleted = 0 AND om.order_type = 'daily_room' AND om.status IN ('pending', 'booked', 'refunding') ORDER BY CASE WHEN om.status = 'pending' THEN 1 WHEN om.status = 'booked' THEN 2 WHEN om.status = 'refunding' THEN 3 ELSE 9 END ASC, om.created_at DESC, om.order_id DESC
